codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex CLI environment hit a runtime issue: its session entered a Stop-hook loop ('hook: Stop'/'hook: Stop Completed' repeated 4000+ lines in /tmp/codex-output-1835687-1777467236.txt) due to a missing/broken /root/.claude/hooks/stop-workflow-enforce.py guard that codex's own session reported it cannot fix from agent context. Codex emitted a help message asking the user to manually restore the hook file ('cd /root/.claude && git show HEAD:hooks/stop-workflow-enforce.py > hooks/stop-workflow-enforce.py && chmod +x hooks/stop-workflow-enforce.py') but never produced substantive review feedback. Codex was running for ~150 seconds before falling back. Per agents/dev.md F-CODEX-DEBATE graceful fallback ('Hang/timeout: same shape with status: failed_timeout'), self-review was substituted.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Self-review substituted. 10 adversarial questions generated and answered (over/under-engineering vs M-section spec, untracked-file porcelain parsing, bounded polling logic correctness with edge cases at t=0 and t=90, safety-tag collision-avoidance with rev-parse --verify -q semantics, M14b runtime test-and-degrade single-emit guarantee, phase-tracking variable transitions across PHASE='P0'->'P1'->'P2'->'P3', destructive-state-on-early-abort safety per phase, regression risk vs deploy.sh hardened behavior, scope drift, /close debate readiness). One minor concern noted (M5 OTHER_UNTRACKED_COUNT semantics — analyzed and confirmed acceptable: sensitive-paths branch aborts unconditionally, so the secondary count never sees them). No blocking bugs found in self-review. All AC1-AC17 traceable in source with line-number evidence.

recommendations: Live verification (the user, in /root/happy TTY): create or identify a real deploy.sh-emitted PRE_TAG, run `cd /root/happy && bash scripts/rollback.sh <tag>` and exercise the four phases (P0 preflight reject by passing a bogus tag; P1 user decline at the M9 confirm; P2 by transient failure; P3 only verifiable in a true daemon-divergence scenario).
